thought.text: Static export exists. Now verifying the dev server works:

reasoning_content: The out/ directory contains the static export. Port 3000 is free. Let's start the dev server in the background, confirm that it serves, and then terminate it.

action.command: cd /workspace && nohup npm run dev > /tmp/devserver.log 2>&1 & echo "started pid $!"; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 2; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null); if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "DEV SERVER UP after ~$((i*2))s (HTTP $code)"; break; fi; done; echo "final code: $code"; tail -10 /tmp/devserver.log

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && nohup npm run dev > /tmp/devserver.log 2>&1 & echo \"started pid $!\"; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 2; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null); if [ \"$code\" = \"200\" ]; then echo \"DEV SERVER UP after ~$((i*2))s (HTTP $code)\"; break; fi; done; echo \"final code: $code\"; tail -10 /tmp/devserver.log", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start dev server in background and verify HTTP 200"}

summary: Start dev server in background and verify HTTP 200
